Data lineage & model logic

Census metrics are parsed client-side from the local BCHACHSAPO.csv file. Facility records are requested from Statistics Canada’s Open Database of Health Facilities, normalized, then strictly retained only where province = BC and city = Vancouver. A local verified fallback keeps the dashboard usable if the federal CDN blocks a browser request.

Allocation guidance is directional: youth share raises pediatric staffing; GNR raises verification and mobile outreach. It is not a clinical decision tool or a replacement for program-level needs assessment.
